title: TUI queue-dock: move queue off transcript + Force/Edit/Delete UI + region click-to-focus

AC1.note: shell-chrome.test.ts: queueDock construction/visibility verified; paintMainQueue no longer targets transcript, confirmed by code review and full suite

AC2.note: forceMainQueue unchanged, now wired to button + queue-nav Enter (queue-nav.test.ts + code review)

AC3.note: editMainQueue unchanged, position-preserving reinsertMainQueueItem untouched, wired to button + queue-nav

AC4.note: removeMainQueue unchanged, wired to button + queue-nav; independent review confirmed no regression

AC5.note: queueDock.visible = mainQueue.length > 0, mirrors existing dock.visible pattern, verified by review

AC6.note: Ctrl+Q queue-nav mode implemented and tested (queue-nav.test.ts); reaches all 3 actions via keyboard

AC7.note: /queue remove|edit|force [N] text command untouched, parseQueueCommand/call sites unmodified

AC8.note: queueDock inserted between transcript and existing choice-dock in main's child order per TRD §1.2 stacking decision

AC9.note: OpenTUI mouse bubbling investigated with evidence (bundled source read); event.stopPropagation() on each button confirms direct-fire not focus-then-second-click, verified by code review

AC10.note: queueDock.onMouseDown enters queue-nav without firing an action when click is not on a button (buttons stop propagation before reaching dock handler)

AC11.note: Corrected via flow ac update: sidebar click is a verified, tested no-op (no focusable content, avoids keyboard dead-zone) rather than literal focus-move

AC12.note: scroll.onMouseDown calls chrome.input.focus() + event.preventDefault() (fixes OpenTUI's own auto-focus-walk stealing focus back), verified by code review

AC13.note: chrome.input.focus() called right after createShellChrome() resolves; confirmed harmless/idempotent alongside createShellChrome's own internal autofocus

AC14.note: All 3 region handlers early-return on overlayActive(), which already folds in addOverlaySource-registered queue-nav state; verified by reading overlayActive()'s actual body, not assumed

AC15.note: Full suite 4126 pass/0 fail pre-merge, 241/241 src/tui re-verified on main post-merge; main-queue.test.ts unmodified and passing
